rejected.reason: Red baroque armchair, 1180x1165, passes every numeric gate item (alpha, 47.6% transparent, clean corners) but looks CG-rendered/over-saturated, has small specks in the carved crest, and is a second ornate gilded armchair next to the emerald Regency one. Spare only.
Persian-style runner in perspective (1100x1650, P mode), not reviewed in detail; traditional red medallion, off-style.
Gold rococo shell mirror, 1000x1809, passes the numbers, but a lilac/grey halo outline is visible around the crest flowers on burgundy. 17336 is a byte-identical duplicate.
Wood radio/record console (best A16 look-alike) is only 518x510. Other record players 111916, 111918, 111924 are 500-800 px.
Orange wood-frame lounge chair is on-palette but 871x928, under 1000 px.
Mustard mid-century lounge chair, 823x823, under 1000 px.
Orange TV is a cartoon illustration, not a photo.
Flat-screen monitor with a transparent screen hole; wrong era.
Gold wire base with black drum shade is on-style but 681x1024 and a table lamp (other lane; lamp shapes previously rejected).
Black arc floor lamp is 660x970, under 1000 px.
Tan sheepskin 663x800; fur 31 (536px) and fur 7 (611x796) also too small.
Eames-style plywood chair has clean 2226x2756 alpha but a modern-showroom look, not shop style; chair 6897 (LCW) and 6848 (red diner, corner patch) are similar spares.
White fabric folding screen with a baked soft shadow; farmhouse/minimal, not shop style.
Wood-framed mirror screen: the mirror panels are transparent holes (burgundy shows through).
StickPNG jukebox cutouts are 283x284; page says free for personal use only.
Arc floor lamp is 896x896 (pngpix standard size), under 1000 px.
Brown tweed sofa with striped pillows has clean 2708x1544 alpha but is suburban-showroom, not shop style.

gaps: Sites actually mined: pngimg.com (category pages armchair, sofa, chair, mirror, carpet, table, lamp, tv, record_player, pillow, bookshelf, fur, bench, rocking_chair), pngpix.com (floor-lamp page, 896 px standard), pngmart.com (folding-screen tag), stickpng.com (jukebox and sheepskin pages, small files), freepngimg.com (jukebox tag page returned no image links).

Searched only via SearXNG queries, never browsed: Wikimedia Commons (jukebox, zebra rug, sunburst mirror queries surfaced only categories and unrelated files), pngall.com and purepng.com (no relevant hits), pngegg.com (search pages only, preview-only risk). A Commons category walk for jukeboxes and a pngall/pngegg crawl are untried.
Zebra, leopard or cheetah rugs/throws: none found on pngimg (animals/fur has only sheepskins and fur scarves) or in search results; cowhide and sheepskin only.
Vintage record-player console/turntable (A16): pngimg record_player has only 500-800 px alpha; needs another source.

Jukebox, pinball machine, globe bar, bar cart, gold etagere, drum/lucite coffee table, tulip/Saarinen table, sunburst mirror, rattan/peacock chair, ottoman: no genuine >=1000 px alpha located on the sites above (only a velvet button cushion-pouf).
Navajo-style blanket/throw: only rugs (kilims, one Aztec rug in perspective) found.
Orange/cream/black flatweave rug not matched exactly; nearest are the rust/cream kilims.
Every file came from pngimg.com (CC BY-NC 4.0). Tight crops mean many hi-res pieces fail the 5% corner rule; see borderline_tight_crop.
